summary.short: Bill PL 3982/2026, presented 17 July 2026, would amend Brazil's Copyright Law (Lei 9.610/1998) to regulate the economic exploitation of intellectual works used in training AI systems, create a proportional remuneration right and refine moral attribution rights.
summary.long: Proposed federal bill by deputy Amom Mandel, presented to the Câmara dos Deputados on 17/07/2026. According to its ementa (summary of purpose), it would amend Law 9.610 of 19 February 1998 (Brazil's Copyright Law) to regulate the economic use of intellectual works within the training of artificial intelligence systems, establish a right to proportional remuneration, and improve moral rights of attribution. The fetched Câmara page contains only the ementa and the procedural record; the articles of the bill (inteiro teor) are not in the document, so specific obligations, thresholds, exceptions and enforcement cannot be described. As of retrieval the bill is listed as awaiting dispatch by the Chamber president.
